Implemented the program information across the site and coordinated the web and email presentation as part of CRF’s front-end and email development responsibilities.

Built the email materials in HTML5 and CSS and supported campaign distribution through Salesforce Pardot as part of CRF’s conference email program.

21.content:
Fellows 2015 was part of CRF’s annual Interventional Cardiology Fellows Course, an educational program serving physicians training in interventional cardiology.

Developed the conference website, responsive/mobile presentation and supporting email communications, implementing the course information across a coordinated digital experience.

Built the front-end with HTML5, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery and supported the conference email work as part of CRF’s broader web and email development responsibilities.

23.content:
Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics (TCT) is CRF’s annual scientific conference focused on the future of interventional cardiology. The 2015 meeting included special guest speakers Arnold Schwarzenegger and Carlo Ancelotti alongside the conference’s medical faculty and educational programming.

Developed TCT materials as part of the CRF front-end team from 2013–2017. Annual responsibilities included development across approximately 8–15 TCT-related conference, sponsor and partner websites, front-end work for TCT Industry, app features and related interfaces, and production of more than 200 emails each year through Salesforce Pardot for CRF, TCT and participating organizations.

The TCT website was built in Joomla with Bootstrap, jQuery, JavaScript, PHP, SCSS, SVG, HTML5 and CSS. Dynamic schedules and interactive interfaces used technologies including AJAX, RESTful APIs and JavaScript, with responsive email development supporting the larger conference campaign.

24.content:
TCT Industry 2015 was the industry-facing companion to CRF’s annual Transcatheter Cardiovascular Therapeutics conference, providing conference information and resources for participating companies and partners.

Developed TCT Industry and related TCT materials as part of the CRF front-end team from 2013–2017. Annual responsibilities included work across approximately 8–15 TCT-related conference, sponsor and partner websites, app features and interfaces, together with production of more than 200 Salesforce Pardot emails each year for CRF, TCT and participating organizations.

The TCT Industry website was built in Joomla with Bootstrap, jQuery, JavaScript, PHP, SCSS, SVG, HTML5 and CSS, with dynamic schedules and interface features using AJAX, RESTful APIs and JavaScript.

25.content:
Columbia Primary Care 2014 (CPC14) was a conference and expo produced through the Cardiovascular Research Foundation as part of CRF’s broader conference web program.

Developed the CPC14 conference website and supporting emails as part of the CRF front-end role. From 2013–2017, responsibilities included development across approximately 8–15 conference, sponsor and partner websites each year, front-end work for CRF’s internal web properties and production of more than 200 annual emails through Salesforce Pardot.

The CPC14 site was built in Joomla with Bootstrap, jQuery, JavaScript and Sass. A simple interactive agenda was developed with JavaScript, AJAX and jQuery. The original conference website is no longer available online.

28.content:

Developed the site structure, responsive layouts and interactive front-end elements using HTML5, CSS, JavaScript and jQuery.

Implemented the conference information so the program could be accessed clearly across desktop and mobile layouts.

34.content:
I Write NY Challenge was a writing and communication initiative created by The Knowledge Project in partnership with the Writers Guild of America and other organizations to help cultivate the next generation of writers, journalists and communicators.

Designed supporting print and digital graphics and developed a dedicated presentation for the initiative within The Know’s website. The site used WordPress with a Twenty Nineteen child theme, Bootstrap, JavaScript and jQuery, with forms handled through WordPress plugins.

Developed and maintained project materials as part of a long-term consulting relationship with The Knowledge Project that expanded into broader website redevelopment and ongoing design and development work.

35.content:
The Parents Club of West Point is an official West Point parent organization that helps families connect with the academy community. Annual membership directories and club materials supported new and returning members with contact information, resources and event communications.

Designed the annual 2016–2017, 2017–2018 and 2018–2019 membership directories together with forms, business cards and supporting club materials.

Developed and maintained the organization’s website and related digital content over several years using WordPress, PHP, Bootstrap, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS while also producing the coordinated print work.

36.content:
Margaret Beals is a dancer and choreographer whose website needed to present career history, performance work and archival material in a clear, image-led format.

Designed the custom page layouts and developed the front-end website using HTML5, CSS and JavaScript.

Created a responsive presentation that organized the portfolio and biographical material for straightforward viewing across screen sizes.

37.content:
Ali is a master hairstylist whose career includes work at Astor Place Hairstylists and MOI, operation of a barbershop in Morocco, participation in major fashion and hairstyling events and a fifth-place finish in the 1982 World Hairstyling Competition.

Designed and developed Ali’s first website while completing college studies, creating the complete visual design and a custom responsive WordPress theme at a time when responsive and adaptive web techniques were still relatively new.

Built the site with WordPress, PHP, Bootstrap, SCSS, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5 and CSS to present services, career information and portfolio content. The website has since been rebranded.
